name: UNBOUND_WARN_INTERVAL_S
desc: How often a run may repeat the "nothing is binding" warning, and how many dead-on-arrival sessions it takes to raise it at all. A conversation whose last turn never got a next state is ordinary; a run where those outnumber the turns that did bind is a correlation failure.

name: FINISH_SECONDS
desc: The agent is told to finish, with the best task it has, this long before its time runs out.

name: DEFAULT_SEED
desc: Rollout defaults; ``kwargs`` on the Harbor agent config override them.

name: CANDIDATE_REASON_LIMIT
desc: The most characters of a refused candidate's reason that the child logs.

name: TRAIN_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S
desc: Ceiling on waiting for one rollout's training steps before moving on with a warning.

name: BATCH_SIZE
desc: The trainer's sample count: the job_samples of ``GeneratedTaskJobData``, one task.

name: REALIGN_THRESHOLD
desc: Tokens a multi-turn sample may realign where a later prompt rewrote an earlier response.

name: INSTALL_TIMEOUT_S
desc: A vendor install clones, builds and downloads; a version probe only execs.

name: MAX_STEPS
desc: Step and tool result budgets; a run also runs under the executor's wall clock.

name: MAX_JOBS_IN_FLIGHT
desc: The most jobs that run or wait at the same time.

name: RESPONSE_ENVELOPE_BYTES
desc: Room for every reply field besides the echoed prompt.

name: MAX_BACKGROUND_POLL_SECONDS
desc: The longest wait, in seconds, between two fallback looks at background work that changed nothing.

name: MAX_CLIENT_COMMANDS
desc: At most this many commands in one report.
